body:
before I begin, I'm on my iPad so expect mistakes, thanks.

the only reason why I was banned was due to my name and Eteh's negative thoughts towards me. He says he doesn't like rule breakers which is fair enough... However, JackHulk1 isn't banned? Also, Eteh has become very rude and inappropriate In the gem speak and in game. Posighdun, you've probably seen it but you never did anything to eteh only me. Alright then, I don't get why I'm still banned, but ok. Oh and also, Jack isn't mine and new didn't unban due to me asking. He unbanned for consideration. Hopefully that nine year old gets stuff through his head and I believe this is a mistake. I
